{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Campaign |prev=[[Battle of Utapau]]{{SWE|characters|tionmedon|Tion Medon}} |conc=*[[Clone Wars]]{{Film|III}} establishes that the occupation of Utapau began under the [[Galactic Republic]], while ''[[Disciples of Harmony]]'' establishes it continued under the [[Galactic Empire]]. Therefore, the occupation must be concurrent to the Republic's [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] into the Empire. Furthermore, ''Revenge of the Sith'' establishes that the [[Clone Wars]] and [[Great Jedi Purge]] occur concurrent to the foundation of the Empire, meaning those conflicts are also concurrent to the occupation of Utapau. *[[Great Jedi Purge]] *[[Proclamation of the New Order]] |next= |image=[[File:Occupation-of-Utapau.png]] |name=Occupation of Utapau |conflict= |begin=[[19 BBY]]{{SWE|characters|tionmedon|Tion Medon}} establishes that the occupation of Utapau began directly after the [[Battle of Utapau]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' states was in [[19 BBY]]. |end= |date= |place=[[Utapau]]''[[Disciples of Harmony]]'' |result= |battles= |side1=*[[Galactic Republic]]† {{C|initially}} *[[Galactic Empire]] |side2=[[Utapaun Security Forces]] |side3= |side4= |commanders1=*[[Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody]]{{Film|III}} *[[Clone Commander]] [[Davijaan]]{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Weapons & Uniforms}} |commanders2=[[Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon]] |commanders3= |commanders4= |forces1=*[[7th Sky Corps]] **[[212th Attack Battalion]] *[[41st Elite Corps]] *[[Clone Flight Squad Seven]] |forces2= |forces3= |forces4= |casual1= |casual2= |casual3= |casual4= |civilian= }} {{Quote|Surrender tastes bitter at first, Cal. But sweetens with time.|Senator Daho Sejan, who surrendered Utapau to the Empire, speaks with [[Jedi Knight]] [[Cal Kestis]]|''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''}} At the end of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Empire]] claimed and '''occupied''' the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Utapau]]. ==Prelude== {{Main|Invasion of Utapau|Battle of Utapau}} Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] made use of the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] [[Utapau]] as a hidden base, [[Invasion of Utapau|oppressing]] the native [[Utapaun]]s—[[Utai]] and [[Pau'an]]s—under a military occupation. An underground''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' [[Utapaun resistance]] emerged in that [[time]] and waited for a chance to strike. As [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived on Utapau in search of [[General]] [[Grievous]], he urged [[Port Administrator]] [[Tion Medon]] to deploy the resistance. In the ensuing [[Battle of Utapau]], the resistance joined the [[7th Sky Corps]] in fighting off the Separatist occupation. ==The occupation== {{Quote|Do you think I wanted Utapau to join the Empire? The compromises I made created a future for my people.''"
"''I've been to Utapau, Senator. They spit your name out like a curse.''"
"''At least they are alive!|Senator Daho Sejan and [[Bode Akuna]]|}} [[File:212th-control-Utapau.png|thumb|left|300px|Clone troopers assumed control over Utapau immediately after working to liberate it from the Separatists.]] With the war's end, however, the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Republic Military]] were turned against the [[Jedi Order]] by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], who longed to turn the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] and issued [[Order 66]] as the Battle of Utapau still raged. After firing on Kenobi and shortly after the world's liberation from the Confederacy, the [[Cloning|clones]] turned on the native Utapauns in what was considered one of the most bitter twists of the entire Clone Wars. Beginning an occupation of their own even as the Republic still existed in a legal sense, the clones shut down and arrested members of the [[Utapaun resistance]], including Medon. With the [[Proclamation of the New Order|final transformation of the Republic into the Empire]] on Palpatine's order, the Empire claimed Utapau as its territory and continued the occupation effort started by the clones. The decision on whether or not to formally join the Empire came down to Utapau's [[Senator|sentorial representative]], [[Daho Sejan]], who believed the regime could not be defeated and thus signed over the world to the Empire. After the Empire took over, much of the [[Pau'an]] population left the planet and settled in other areas of [[the galaxy]]. The Empire set up fortifications across Utapau that guarded the [[sinkhole]]s where many of the residents of the planet lived. While much of the Utapaun population who remained on world hated Sejan for his role in surrendering the planet, he believed he had given them a future and kept them alive. {{Battle-stub}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} ==Sources== {{IncompleteList}} *{{SWE|characters|tionmedon|Tion Medon}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|45|Weapons & Uniforms}} *''[[Disciples of Harmony]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' *''[[Star Wars 100 Objects]]'' *{{HotToysCite|set=Movie Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#851: 212th Attack Battalion Clone Trooper|link=collectibles/star-wars-212th-attack-battalion-clone-trooper-hot-toys-915101}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Utapau, occupation of}} [[Category:Battles of Utapau]] [[Category:Campaigns during the Imperial Era]] [[Category:Campaigns during the Republic Era]] [[Category:Campaigns in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Conquests and occupations]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]]
